title: Etale cohomology pullback on a chosen resolution
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X\to S, a nonnegative integer q, an abelian etale sheaf F and the chosen injective resolution I, etale chart cohomology pullback, including inverse-image composition, agrees under normalizationRestrictedIso with restriction on homology of normalizationPresheafComplex. All maps and the augmentation are those of [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data].

source.place: Tag 03Q8; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 072W; derived.tex Tags 0DVC and 09T5; fixed-resolution part of the parent normalization argument.

proof.text: For any prescribed resolution I, form the restriction comparison degreewise from inverse-image composition. Naturality of the single-complex comparison, its composition law, and naturality of the augmentation give the augmentation square. Apply the existing etale K-injective pullback abutment theorem to the two restricted resolutions. The native Mathlib resolution comparison is definitionally the inverse of resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso, so this identifies chart cohomology pullback with homology of the section-chain comparison.

The section-chain map has components sectionsPullbackNat followed by global sections of the inverse-image composition comparison. The sections-unit identity and objectSections_naturality identify these components, under normalizationSectionsIso, with restriction of the original sheaf. Applying homology gives the square on section homology. NatTrans.app_homology for the natural transformation between evaluation functors gives naturality of the final homology-evaluation factors.
Compose the two squares, cancel the intermediate resolution isomorphisms, and specialize I to injectiveResolution F. All equations apply in degree zero, for zero coefficients, and on empty charts.
